map.每核子的平均结合能，反映核稳定性。: The average binding energy per nucleon, which reflects nuclear stability.
map.比结合能 = 结合能 ÷ 质量数 A；结合能 BE = Δm × c²，其中质量: Specific binding energy = binding energy / mass number A; binding energy BE = Δm x c², where the mass defect Δm = Z x proton mass + N x neutron mass - nuclear mass, with c² taken as 931.5 MeV/u (1 u equals 931.494 MeV), i.e. BE(MeV) = Δm(u) x 931.5. The specific binding energy curve peaks near A about 56 (the iron peak) at roughly 8.8 MeV/nucleon, the most stable region; fusion of light nuclei and fission of heavy nuclei both move toward the iron peak and release energy.
map.铁峰约 8.8 MeV/核子。: The iron peak is about 8.8 MeV/nucleon.
map.比结合能越大越稳定。: A larger specific binding energy means greater stability.
map.总结合能 ÷ 核子数得每核子结合能（MeV/核子）。: Total binding energy divided by the number of nucleons gives the binding energy per nucleon (MeV/nucleon).
map.原子核稳定性与核子数关系（铁峰）。: How nuclear stability relates to nucleon number (the iron peak).
map.对比轻核/重核的比结合能。: Compare the specific binding energy of light and heavy nuclei.
map.总结合能 = 0.528 × 931.5 ≈ 491.8 MeV；比结合能 =: Total binding energy = 0.528 x 931.5 ≈ 491.8 MeV; specific binding energy = 491.8 / 56 ≈ 8.78 MeV/nucleon, close to the peak and hence most stable.
map.若 A=4（He-4）比结合能约 7.07 MeV/核子，低于铁，故聚变动能释放: For A=4 (He-4) the specific binding energy is about 7.07 MeV/nucleon, below iron, so fusion releases energy.
map.比结合能最高点在哪里？: Where is the maximum of the specific binding energy?
map.铁-56 附近约 8.8 MeV/核子为峰值，是核最稳定的区域。: Near iron-56, at about 8.8 MeV/nucleon, is the peak and the most stable region for nuclei.
map.1u 对应的能量 MeV（1u·c²≈931.5 MeV），用于质量亏损转结合能: The energy in MeV corresponding to 1 u (1 u·c² ≈ 931.5 MeV), used to turn a mass defect into binding energy.
